title: Quantum partial permutations in action
description:
Preprint (40 pages, PDF and LaTeX source), together with the 13 Python programs used for its computations.

We study quantum partial permutations through magic completions, fixed points and partial graph symmetries. Cliques in the association graph describe classical partial isomorphisms, while walks give a basis for the quantum algebra. The abstract algebra recovers the association graph, and every polynomial attains its universal norm in a finite matrix representation. We determine how many fixed-point projections remain free at each rank and obtain Poisson and free Poisson limits. We classify partial Hadamard matrices with commuting row-quotient projections above row density 5/9 and describe partial translations of Fourier row restrictions.
